name: @loom/order-lines
description: loom-ui's empty binding state for anyone (loom ADR 0100, gap G5): an order-detail board where a dependent widget's own step chains off an upstream 'top orders' step by a {{steps.…}} template. When there is no top order the template indexes past the end of a real (empty) array — the upstream answered, just with no such row — and the widget shows 'No data' (web: role="status"; terminal: the ○ row), never an error and never repaired. A genuinely bad template path (a typo'd key, not an index) still errors, on a non-empty upstream, so the two are never confused.
